title: Ezra header
description: A cream top bar that sticks to the top of the window: a co-brand wordmark on the left; four plain 16px links, a person-icon sign-in link and a terracotta pill on the right. On phones the links fold into a burger that drops a full-width cream panel (a details disclosure, no JavaScript).
notes: 90px tall on desktop, 70px on phones; sticky for the whole page, as the original
